cells.text: Dive that applies Cure x2 to the user and their allies within 9 meters. While Heat Rises is active: Applies Restoration x2 for 3+1.5 seconds upon diving. Deals 100 damage and inflicts x40+20 Scorch to enemies within 6.5 metres upon landing.

Dive that applies Cure x2 to the user and their allies within 9 meters. While Heat Rises is active: Applies Restoration x2 for 3+1.5 seconds upon diving. Deals 100 damage and x40+20 Scorch to enemies within 5 metres upon landing.

compendium_text_normalization: Whitespace collapsed for comparison; original HTML bytes are archived.

conflicts.resolution: No global default. The ability requires explicit blast_radius calibration; the native acceptance fixture selects 5 m.

cure.when: First accepted physical landing of the saved casting life

policies: Heat Rises is sampled at cast acceptance; Ashes and outgoing damage are evaluated at landing.
Native velocity uses explicit additive impulses; neutral input does not erase existing velocity. Missing input cannot invent a direction.
The saved pending life survives unequip and has no guessed fall timer; same-life confirmed death or removal cancels it.
Consume pending before same-life liveness verification and benefit commands; rejection or unknown results never refund the accepted cast or replay committed operations.
Cure and explosion query historical landing feet, spherical inclusive radii, no line-of-sight; host allied entities can receive Cure.
Scorch requires an applied nonlethal blast, per-target authorization and no scorch_lockout. First-source Solar snapshots preserve class and ability credit.
Only one pending cast is allowed for this ability. A new paid cast can complete independently; no global chain-depth or feedback prohibition.
Solar payload scaling is a standing owner/system source, not an effect of selecting Phoenix Dive. A paid dive deselected before landing still captures positive shared Scorch damage.
gaps: Additive horizontal 3 m/s and downward 12 m/s, flat falloff and 0.1 health projection are synthetic calibration, not measured Destiny motion/damage.
Minimum height, velocity replacement, original input timing, camera and actual client trajectory are uncalibrated.
Heat Rises activation, Daybreak interaction, original refresh/unequip/sampling policies and all exotic/mod combinations remain incomplete.
Formal subclass equipment, production skill catalogue, HUD/assets and physical-world restart restoration are incomplete; current definitions remain acceptance resources.
